struct.name: Vef_GenericSensor_Object
struct.comment: Specification of an object detected by a sensor

element.name: position_cartesian
element.comment: Structure: Center position of the object in cartesian coordinates

element.name: position_cartesian_std_dev
element.comment: Structure: Standard deviation of the center position of the object in cartesian coordinates

element.name: speed_cartesian
element.comment: Structure: Speed of the object in cartesian coordinates

element.name: speed_cartesian_std_dev
element.comment: Structure: Standard deviation of the speed of the object in cartesian coordinates

element.name: acceleration_cartesian
element.comment: Structure: Acceleration of the object in cartesian coordinates

element.name: acceleration_cartesian_std_dev
element.comment: Structure: Standard deviation of the acceleration of the object in cartesian coordinates

element.name: size
element.comment: Structure: Size of the object

element.name: bounding_box_offset
element.comment: Offset of bounding box

element.name: angle_rates
element.comment: Structure: Angle rates

element.name: speed_abs
element.comment: Structure: Absolute velocity

element.name: speed_rotation_compensated
element.comment: Structure: Rotation-compensated velocity

element.name: acceleration_abs
element.comment: Structure: Absolute acceleration

element.name: acceleration_rotation_compensated
element.comment: Structure: Rotation-compensated acceleration

element.name: detection_time
element.comment: Structure: Timestamp when the object was detected first by the sensor

element.name: assigned_lane_percentage
element.comment: Percentage value of the object's width in the corresponding lane

element.name: position_nearest_point
element.comment: Structure: Position of the closest point on a detected object

element.name: validity_mask
element.comment: Enumeration: Vef_GenericSensor_ObjectValidityMask - Validity mask of Object

element.name: color
element.comment: Enumeration: Vef_GenericSensor_ObjectColor - Dominant color of the object

element.name: object_id
element.comment: Unique Id of the object

element.name: object_type
element.comment: Enumeration: Vef_Base_ObjectType - Type of the object

element.name: cartesian_coordinate_system
element.comment: Enumeration: Vef_Base_CartesianCoordinateSystem - Object is described in the chosen cartesian coordinate system

element.name: detected_id
element.comment: Detected id

element.name: lane_id
element.comment: List of lane ids the detected object is assigned to. The list is not sorted in a hierarchical manner

element.name: visibility
element.comment: Visibility of traffic object from 0 to 100

element.name: brake_state
element.comment: Enumeration: Vef_GenericSensor_BrakeStates - States of brake

element.name: indicator_right
element.comment: Enumeration: Vef_GenericSensor_IndicatorRight - States of right indicator

element.name: indicator_left
element.comment: Enumeration: Vef_GenericSensor_IndicatorLeft - States of left indicator

element.name: valid_sensors
element.comment: Number of sensors that detected the object

element.name: source_sensor_ids
element.comment: Ids of sensors that detected the object

element.name: tracking_id
element.comment: Id of the object as assigned by the sensor internally

element.name: connected_ids
element.comment: Global ids of objects that are connected to the deteced object, such as trailers connected to vehicles

element.name: occlusion_ratio
element.comment: The ratio of occlusion describes how much of an object is obstructed by another object

element.name: valid_lane_ids
element.comment: Number of valid lane_ids in lane_id array

element.name: valid_connected_ids
element.comment: Number of valid global ids of connected objects in connected_ids array

element.name: reserved
element.comment: Reserved for padding and later use

struct.name: Vef_GenericSensor_Objects
struct.comment: A list of objects detected by a sensor

element.name: version
element.comment: Structure: Version of the VEF Data Model Generic Sensor

element.name: objects
element.comment: Structure: List of objects

element.name: valid_objects
element.comment: Number of valid objects in array

element.name: reserved
element.comment: Reserved for padding and later use
